name: System Monitor
description: Live CPU, memory & disk monitoring. Uses bottom (btm) for a beautiful TUI.
author: strIDEterm

workspaceDefaults.name: System Monitor
workspaceDefaults.notes:
Real-time system performance monitor with graphs.

Recommended: Install 'bottom' for a beautiful TUI dashboard:
  Windows: winget install Clement.bottom
  Linux:   snap install bottom  (or see github.com/ClementTsang/bottom)
  macOS:   brew install bottom

Then reopen this tab. Without bottom, a basic PowerShell/top fallback is used.

win32.command: "C:\Program Files\bottom\bin\btm.exe" 2>nul || btm 2>nul || powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { Write-Host 'bottom (btm) not found. Install it:' -Fore Yellow; Write-Host '  winget install Clement.bottom' -Fore Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Then restart this tab.' -Fore Gray; pause }"

recommendedPackages.name: bottom
recommendedPackages.description: A cross-platform graphical process/system monitor with a beautiful TUI

recommendedPackages.name: btop
recommendedPackages.description: Resource monitor with a rich TUI (alternative)
